base_protocol.inheritance_rule: Deep-copy the base JSON and apply every JSON-Pointer replacement in overrides exactly. Fields not named by an override are inherited byte-semantically from v0. The amendment file and its pinned base together are the complete v1 protocol.

change_control.rule: Any further scientific or interface change requires a new protocol ID or revision. Qualification may accept or reject v1 but may not silently edit it.

rationale.timing: Frozen before any formal multi-fidelity qualification episode produced a scientific observation.
rationale.design_bounds: Replace the unbounded finite-vector action space with the pre-existing population-standardized search cube used by the original frozen CMA-ES studies. A shared physical [-100,100] box is rejected because the 38 coordinates have different units and scales.
rationale.ld_envelope: The pre-existing off-manifold stress test found rare near-zero predicted-drag artifacts, including an individual predicted L/D of 1368.186 and complete three-condition scores that hid individual L/D values of 96.415 or 177.218. A per-condition rather than aggregate envelope is therefore required.

overrides./purpose: Measure how well an optimizer allocates cheap AeroTransformer and expensive whole-wing CFD observations to deliver one high-L/D, benchmark-eligible SuperWing inside the frozen standardized design box.
overrides./objective/defined_only_if: all three CFD conditions satisfy the underlying CFD-validity contract, all three L/D values are finite and positive, and every per-condition L/D is at most 40.0

/objective/per_condition_ld_envelope.aggregation_rule: Apply the envelope before the three-condition geometric mean. One out-of-envelope condition makes the whole-wing benchmark score undefined even when the other conditions are in range.
/objective/per_condition_ld_envelope.raw_evidence_policy: Never clip an L/D value to 40. Preserve and return every trustworthy raw CL, CD, and L/D value with reason code per_condition_ld_above_40.
/objective/per_condition_ld_envelope.semantics: This is a prospectively frozen benchmark objective envelope, not a claim that every CFD solution above 40 is physically impossible.

/design_action/coordinate_bounds.action_validation: Every physical coordinate must lie inside its own inclusive physical interval.

overrides./design_action/malformed_action: Wrong length, unparseable values, NaN, positive/negative infinity, or any coordinate outside its frozen inclusive interval is rejected before evaluation and consumes no evaluator query or cost. Values are never clipped, projected, or repaired.
overrides./design_action/semantic_failure: Any finite in-bounds 38-vector is admitted. Geometry-construction, adapter, meshing, solver, or objective-envelope failure is an evaluated outcome and consumes the applicable query and realized evaluator cost.

/cheap_evaluator/objective_envelope.rule: A cheap whole-wing score exists only when all three ordinary trim-valid conditions also have finite positive L/D not exceeding 40.0.

/cfd_evaluator/benchmark_objective_envel.rule: After preserving the complete raw CFD grade, the benchmark defines no online or terminal objective score if any trustworthy per-condition CFD L/D exceeds 40.0.

/reporting/primary_endpoints: terminal delivery rate: fraction of episodes whose terminal wing is CFD-valid at all three conditions and satisfies the per-condition L/D objective envelope
terminal CFD geometric-mean L/D conditional on benchmark delivery
/reporting/diagnostics: selection-induced surrogate signed error, absolute error, and rank agreement only on geometries receiving CFD
surrogate completion versus CFD completion confusion table only on selected geometries
raw and benchmark-eligible outcomes for every per-condition L/D envelope violation

formal_campaign_policy.infrastructure_only_attempts_before_v1: Retain as administrative evidence but never mix them into v1 scientific results.
formal_campaign_policy.optimizer_packages: Every optimizer package must bind this amendment and its pinned base and must enforce the v1 action and observation semantics before formal execution.
